description: Generates Chinese-language academic course paper reviews (课程论文综述) with strict formatting (小四 + 宋体 + 双倍行距) and exports to both .docx and .pdf via python-docx + libreoffice headless. Enforces GB/T 7714-2015 citation format with mandatory web verification of all references before inclusion.
useCase: Students writing Chinese university course papers (typically ~20 pages on a specific algorithm or technology) need references verified to publisher/journal pages, a 9-chapter outline approved by the user, and final output in both Word and PDF formats. Manual formatting and reference hunting typically takes days; this skill automates the entire pipeline with academic integrity safeguards.

risks.risk: AI-generated content can include fabricated references that look plausible but do not exist.
risks.mitigation: Mandatory web verification of every reference against DOI or journal page before inclusion in the bibliography.

risks.risk: Chinese font rendering on Linux requires Noto Serif CJK fallback when 宋体 is not installed locally.
risks.mitigation: OOXML eastAsia attribute is set correctly in python-docx so Word/WPS renders Chinese; LibreOffice falls back to Noto Serif CJK for PDF.

risks.risk: matplotlib dependency install can hang silently during skill setup on some systems.
risks.mitigation: Use Pillow (PIL) for academic diagram generation instead, which is typically pre-installed and faster to set up.

output.format: 20+ page .docx (Word) and .pdf (via soffice --headless) with embedded Chinese font fallback and inline academic figures.
